name: Servant Leaders
overview: Scripture reveals that true leadership in the kingdom of God is characterized by humble service rather than exercising authority or lordship over others. Jesus teaches that those who desire greatness must become servants, exemplified by His own ministry of serving and giving His life as a ransom. His actions, such as washing His disciples' feet, model servant leadership as the highest form of greatness, calling leaders to adopt the posture of the youngest and the one who serves rather than the one who rules.
